items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 61:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Hassadim of AB of Yodin (Yuds)? The Mochin of Chaya that the Nukva receives from the NHY of ZA, by which she returns with him face to face in an equal stature, are called by the name the Hassadim of AB of Yodin. But the Mochin of the AB of the Mazalot that she receives while she is with ZA in his back, although they too are from the aspect of AB, nevertheless they are not discerned as the AB of Yodin, which means Mochin of Chaya, but are discerned as the AB of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which is in Gematria 216. As above in Answer 60. (Item 104).
